signal: Minitab was named to the G2 2026 Best Software Awards for Best Data Analytics Software and is expanding AI capabilities across its statistical and Engage products

email.body1:
Lisa, saw Minitab landed on the G2 2026 Best Software list and keeps expanding AI across the statistical and Engage products.

Pushing new products like that usually means more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisa, quick follow-up for Minitab.

As you push AI-enhanced products into the install base, the number tends to climb faster than your team can ramp, and most BD orgs cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Minitab needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisa, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to other established analytics software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisa, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most while you are pushing new AI products, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an analytics-software motion? I will tailor it to Minitab either way.
